title: Tajne u kodu i git istoriji
summary: Otkrivanje tajni u kodu i git istoriji gitleaksom i TruffleHogom, sprječavanje curenja pre-commit hookom, push protectionom, baselineom i allowlistama, i odgovor na procurjelu tajnu: opoziv, rotacija, istraga i prepisivanje istorije.
title_en: Secrets in code and git history
summary_en: Detecting secrets in code and git history with gitleaks and TruffleHog, preventing leaks with a pre-commit hook, push protection, baselines and allowlists, and responding to a leaked secret: revoke, rotate, investigate and rewrite history.
